Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Pelicans.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Pelicans (confidence, revenge).
Bottom line: the Clippers win 60 times in 100, by about 3; most games like this end between 210 and 258 total points.
